scenes.setting: Fors clears her altar, counting twelve pairs of black wings from her reverie — an angel of the highest rank as routine service for Mr. Fool? Is 'He' Death reborn through the Tarot Gatherings? — and settles on Roselle's advice: take things one step at a time

Above the gray fog (visions only: Daisy's kidnapping by two capped men, the dagger in the carriage, the dark room in Capim's villa, her cries for Mother and Freja): divination confirms Capim's trafficking ring; the spirit pendulum spins — rescue is dangerous but possible. 'Wasn't I looking for an opportunity to perform? This is it!'
scenes.text_anchor: This meant that saving Daisy was a rather dangerous act!

scenes.setting: A henchman leaving Capim's villa is ridden Spirit-Body-style to a cheap hotel — but his Spirit Body carries an unknown seal that would alert the enemy if mediumship is forced. Klein's answer: possess the unconscious man outright and have him chant The Fool's honorific name at the altar
scenes.text_anchor: “Do you think you can stop me with just this?”
